requirements.title: Exceptional floating-point classes are subnormal, infinity, and NaN
requirements.definition: ISO/IEC 60559 specifies subnormal values as very small values with reduced precision, infinities as values created by overflow or division by zero, and NaNs as undefined values or values created by invalid operations.
